record.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — Imported feed HTML is stored using `raw_html`, bypassing sanitization in `Post#cook` and allowing scripts and event handlers to survive as stored XSS on the forum’s origin; sanitize imported HTML before storing or rendering it.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in topic_embed.rb line 22, PostCreator is called with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`. Looking at post.rb lines 131-133, when cook_method is raw_html, the cook method returns `raw` directly without any processing. The imported content from RSS feeds (poll_feed.rb) or remote URLs (import_remote via ruby-readability) is stored and rendered without sanitization. While ruby-readability limits tags to 'div p code pre h1 h2 h3 b em i strong a img', this still allows event handlers like onclick on those elements, and RSS content in poll_feed.rb uses CGI.unescapeHTML which doesn't sanitize. The content is then rendered with `raw post.cooked` in best.html.erb, creating a stored XSS vulnerability.
